{{< include ../_include/_title_meta_items.qmd >}}

```{python}
#| include: false
#| context: local
import os, glob
from pathlib import Path
_dots_dir = Path("../_include/sv_dots").resolve()
%run ../_include/_graphviz.py

def _load_dot(stem: str) -> str:
    dot_path = _dots_dir / f"{stem}.dot"
    if dot_path.exists():
        return dot_path.read_text()
    return ""
```

## Constraints

### ck_even

```{python}
#| label: fig-ck-even
#| fig-cap: "ck_even: 1-LUT even parity check"
d = _load_dot("ck_even")
dot(d, h="200px") if d else None
```

### ck_gt


| Module | Description | Logic |
|---|---|---|
| `ck_even` | 1 LUT parity check | XOR reduction |
| `ck_range_010` | Hard-coded [0,10] comparator | 2 comparators + AND |
| `ck_range` | Parameterized [min, max] | 2 comparators + AND |
| `ck_eq` | Equality check | 64-bit XOR + NOR tree |
| `ck_gt` | Greater-than check | 64-bit comparator |

| Module | Lines | Gates (approx) |
|---|---|---|
| `ck_even` | 12 | 1 LUT |
| `ck_range_010` | 485 | ~130 gates |
| `ck_range` | 365 | ~130 gates |
| `ck_eq` | 325 | ~130 gates |
| `ck_gt` | 325 | ~130 gates |
| `proj_identity` | 10 | 64 buffers |
| `proj_sum2d` | 2,498 | 64-bit adder |
| `proj_sum3d` | 4,077 | 128-bit adder chain |
| `proj_parity` | 10 | 1 buffer |
| `proj_negate` | 1,156 | 64-bit negation |
| `compose_union` | 15 | 1 OR |
| `compose_intersect` | 15 | 1 AND |
| `compose_product_2d` | 12 | 1 AND |
| `observe` | 524 | pipeline control |
